# NeutralAudioSkin

The audio preset's visually lighter skin, closer to a classic control bar

The neutral skin of the audio preset: the same player and the same controls in a visually lighter design, closer to a classic control bar. The preset also provides [AudioSkin](./audio-skin.md), [CompatAudioSkin](./audio-compat-skin.md), and [ScaffoldAudioSkin](./audio-scaffold-skin.md). See [Skins](../../guides/skins.md#choose-a-skin) to choose between them and [Presets](../../guides/presets.md) for what the audio preset ships.

## Import

```tsx
import { NeutralAudioSkin } from '@videojs/react/audio';
import '@videojs/react/audio/neutral-skin.css';
```

## Anatomy

The skin goes between the player and the media component. It renders its controls around the media.

```tsx
<AudioPlayer>
  <NeutralAudioSkin>
    <Audio />
  </NeutralAudioSkin>
</AudioPlayer>
```

## Styling

Packaged skins style themselves and expose a small set of public CSS custom properties. Everything else inside the skin is private and may change between releases. [Customize skins](../../guides/customize-skins.md#style-a-packaged-skin) documents the properties. For deeper changes, the Video.js registry provides the skin files.

## Examples

### Basic Usage

**App.tsx**

```tsx
import { Audio, AudioPlayer, NeutralAudioSkin } from '@videojs/react/audio';

import '@videojs/react/audio/neutral-skin.css';

export default function BasicUsage() {
  return (
    <AudioPlayer>
      <NeutralAudioSkin className="react-audio-neutral-skin-basic">
        <Audio src="https://stream.mux.com/BV3YZtogl89mg9VcNBhhnHm02Y34zI1nlMuMQfAbl3dM/audio.m4a" crossOrigin="anonymous" />
      </NeutralAudioSkin>
    </AudioPlayer>
  );
}
```

**App.css**

```css
.react-audio-neutral-skin-basic {
  width: 100%;
}
```

## Own the UI

Packaged skins keep their controls and layout inside Video.js. When you need to add, remove, rearrange, or deeply restyle controls, use Shadcn to add the skin source to your project. Its components, layout, styles, and interactions become local files you can change.

- [Install Video.js with Shadcn](../../guides/installation-shadcn.md#choose-how-to-install): Add editable skin source and build a working React or HTML player
